description: Curated parcel-driver matching evaluation set for the ShipIT AI engine. Ground-truth labels are human logistics judgments (best route coverage of pickup->drop plus reliability/capacity). Routes are seeded corridor-only (origin->destination; waypoints omitted) because the offline feature-hash embedder dilutes cosine similarity with non-matching tokens - a documented limitation of the deterministic embedder. Includes clean cases and deliberately hard near-tie cases (identical-corridor competitors with higher ratings) so reported accuracy is honest.
